body_es: Python ofrece open() con context managers para leer y escribir archivos de texto y binarios de forma segura.
body_en: Python offers open() with context managers to safely read and write text and binary files.
example_code:
# Writing and reading a file
import io
buf = io.StringIO()
buf.write('Hello\nWorld')
buf.seek(0)
for line in buf:
    print(line.strip())
